brief_rationale: The trajectory successfully completes all minimum responsibility-chain duties: confirms preoperative handoff need, corrects the antibiotic self-administration misunderstanding, screens for red-flag symptoms, provides a concrete offline handoff plan, and obtains clear family read-back. One high-order point (HO3) is completed through targeted allergy history inquiry beyond minimum duty. Two other high-order points (HO1, HO2) show partial completion. The grade is 4 (Strong) as there is no responsibility-chain error, no important non-chain defect, and at least one completed high-order point with meaningful trajectory impact.
